title: Fix Plank & Squash monthly volumes: sum ticked days and apply correct month-based targets (Plank +15s after Feb, Squash fixed 45:00)

requirements.text: Fix Plank time progression so that February is the base month at 1:15, and each month after February increases the *daily* Plank target by +15 seconds (e.g., Mar = 1:30, Apr = 1:45), without incorrectly treating the increment as minutes.

quotes: I mean for the habit plank in February I do 1:15. In march I want to increase it to 1:30 and April 1:45.
Correct add 15 seconds to plank which is what I will be aiming to hit everyday

acceptanceCriteria: When the stored/edited Plank value for February is 1:15, the computed/stored values for March and April are 1:30 and 1:45 respectively (and continue +15s for subsequent months).
The app no longer produces Plank monthly values like 16:00 or 31:00 as a result of the +15 increment (i.e., no minutes-vs-seconds bug).
Plank volume entries retain a seconds-accurate representation (e.g., timeString "1:15") so monthly totals can compute correctly at second granularity.
This progression rule is applied consistently in both backend compounding (Motoko) and frontend optimistic compounding (TypeScript) so values don’t ‘snap back’ after refresh.

requirements.text: Keep Squash daily target fixed at 45:00 across all months (no month-to-month compounding), and ensure that this fixed value is used when calculating monthly totals from completed/ticked days.

quotes: can you make it so every month after February adds 15 seconds to the plank and that squash stays at 45 minutes
I want you to calculate the volume of plank across the month as normal along with the same for the other habits.

acceptanceCriteria: For the Squash habit, the per-day volume displays as 45:00 for every month tab (Jan–Dec) once set, with no auto-increase.
If N days are ticked completed for Squash in a selected month, the Monthly total for Squash equals N × 45:00 (formatted correctly as time).
Backend persistence for Squash does not introduce future-month drift (e.g., later months remain 45:00 after refresh).

requirements.text: Ensure monthly totals for all habits (including Plank and Squash) are calculated as: (number of ticked/completed days in the selected month) × (that habit’s per-day target for the selected month), and displayed correctly in each habit row and in the Monthly Volume Summary.

quotes: Looks good. Can you get the volumes to add up when selected/ ticked completed?
I want you to calculate the volume of plank across the month as normal along with the same for the other habits.

acceptanceCriteria: Toggling a day checkbox for any habit updates that habit’s displayed “Monthly total” to reflect the new completed-days count × per-day volume for the selected month.
For time-based habits, monthly totals are computed with seconds accuracy when a timeString exists and are formatted as M:SS.
The Monthly Volume Summary aggregates totals using these same computed monthly totals (reps summed as numbers; time summed as seconds and formatted as M:SS).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.frontend.immutablePaths.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding new habit types, analytics dashboards, streak logic, reminders, or notifications.
Introducing external databases or third-party auth providers (Internet Identity only).
